User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the DevCollab Hub application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the user's profile image.

skills.description: List of professional skills possessed by the user.

techStack.description: List of technologies the user is familiar with.

yearsOfExperience.description: The amount of experience in years.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a project created by a user for collaboration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Project entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Project). The ID of the user who owns the project.

requiredTechStack.description: List of technologies required for the project.

requiredSkills.description: List of professional skills required for the project.

requiredYearsOfExperience.description: The minimum years of experience required for collaborators.

collaborationOpen.description: Indicates whether the project is open for collaboration.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the project was created.

interestedUsers.description: List of user IDs who have shown interest in the project.

matchedUsers.description: List of user IDs who have matched with the project.

viewCount.description: The number of times the project has been viewed.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a match between a user and a project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

projectId.description: Reference to Project. The ID of the project involved in the match.

ownerId.description: The ID of the project owner.

matchedUserId.description: The ID of the user who was matched.

participants.description: An array containing the UIDs of both participants for easy querying.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the match was created.

status.description: Status of the match (e.g., active, closed).

archivedBy.description: List of user IDs who have archived this match.

unreadCounts.description: An object storing the unread message count for each participant.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single chat message within a match.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user.

fromUserId.description: The UID of the user who triggered the notification.

read.description: Indicates whether the notification has been read.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post.

title.description: The title of the blog post.

content.description: The main content of the blog post in Markdown or HTML format.

imageUrl.description: URL of the featured image for the blog post.

authorName.description: The display name of the author.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the post was last updated.

isPublished.description: Whether the blog post is visible to the public.

Engagement.title: Engagement
Engagement.description: Represents a professional engagement between a developer and an advisor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Engagement entity.

developerId.description: The UID of the developer who initiated the engagement.

developerPhotoURL.description: The photo URL of the developer.

advisorPhotoURL.description: The photo URL of the advisor.

advisorHeadline.description: The headline of the advisor at the time of engagement.

advisorApplicationId.description: The ID of the specific advisor application used for this engagement.

status.description: The current status of the engagement.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the engagement was created.

developerRequest.description: The initial request details sent by the developer.

subject.description: The subject line of the engagement request.

message.description: The detailed message from the developer.

selectedDeliverables.description: A list of standard deliverables selected by the developer.

proposedTimeline.description: The developer's proposed timeline for the engagement.

constraints.description: Any constraints or special considerations from the developer.

definition.description: Stores match data between users and projects.
Subcollection for chat messages within a match.
Stores engagement data between developers and advisors.
